item.title: Kioxia and Nvidia Partner to Extend GPU Memory to Petabyte Scale
item.description:
Kioxia and Nvidia have launched a proof-of-concept on a GB200 NVL72 rack system equipped with 144 KIOXIA XD8 NVMe SSDs totaling roughly 1.1PB, combining them with Nvidia's SCADA software library to break past HBM memory limits via 512-byte granular random access to SSDs. The test targets a database of about 2 trillion vectors and also covers large-scale datasets used by graph neural networks.

原文标题：铠侠英伟达联手将 GPU 显存扩展至 PB 级

Why it matters：以 SSD 扩展 GPU 有效显存至 PB 级，直击 AI 推理与向量检索的内存墙瓶颈，是算力基础设施的重要探索方向。

item.title: SpaceX Cuts AI Compute Rental Prices by Up to 35 Percent
item.description:
SemiAnalysis reports that SpaceX has cut spot rental prices for Blackwell GPUs from roughly $15 per GPU-hour to $10-12, a 20-35% reduction. Uncertainty has also emerged over whether Anthropic will renew a contract covering about 50,000 H200 GPUs, while SpaceX is already offering capacity to new customers at around $5 per GPU-hour, potentially intensifying price competition in AI compute.

原文标题：SpaceX 下调 AI 算力租赁价格 降幅最高 35%

Why it matters：头部算力供应商大幅降价叠加核心客户续约存疑，是观察 AI 算力供需与定价走向的重要信号。

item.title: China-Led AI Training Data Quality Standard Adopted Across 30+ European Nations
item.description:
The ISO/IEC 5259-4:2024 international standard on AI training data quality, led by Chinese experts, has been adopted by European bodies as a key technical reference for AI compliance assessment in more than 30 European countries, covering data collection, labeling and quality judgment. The standard defines lifecycle quality management processes and technical requirements for training data, marking a notable step in China's deeper participation in global AI rule-making.

原文标题：中国牵头 AI 训练数据质量国际标准获欧洲 30 余国采纳

Why it matters：训练数据质量首次成为跨国合规技术基准，直接影响数据治理与模型合规路径。

item.title: Qualcomm Oryon 3 Tops Single-Threaded PC Performance
item.description:
Qualcomm's third-generation in-house Oryon architecture, shipping in the Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme, now delivers CPU performance that challenges the best x86-64 competitors, marking the maturation of its Arm PC push from an underwhelming start. The author's hands-on testing finds single-threaded performance near desktop-class and calls for continued iteration to hold the lead.

item.title: OpenAI Fixes GPT-6.2 Billing Error, Usage Limits Hit 40% Faster
item.description:

After the fix, users hit plan limits 40% and 25% faster respectively, though OpenAI says both still stretch further than 6 Astra and 6.1 Sol; past usage won't be charged and Go, Plus, Pro and Business users get one banked reset as compensation.

item.title: Amodei Rejects Claims He Advocates Handing Control to AI
item.description:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly rejected claims that he advocates handing human free will to AI, calling the idea absurd and insisting AI must be governed by democratic processes with humans retaining final decision authority. He distinguished task automation from surrendering autonomy, warned about recursive self-improvement risks, and criticized rivals for contradictory automation messaging.

原文标题：阿莫迪否认主张人类交出 AI 控制权

Why it matters：头部 AI 实验室掌门人罕见公开回应治理争议，涉及 AI 控制权与自动化边界这一核心议题。

item.title: Anthropic Cuts Riemann Hypothesis Proof Code by 99.5% Using Claude
item.description:
Anthropic researcher Luke Sernau and colleagues used Claude to rewrite and refactor a 17.4-million-line Lean formalization of the Riemann Hypothesis down to roughly 76,000 lines, a 99.56% reduction. The new version builds in one to two hours on an ordinary 12-core, 24GB machine, versus 21 hours on high-end AWS hardware for the original. The effort answers community criticism that the original proof was too large to verify.

原文标题：Anthropic 用 Claude 将黎曼猜想证明代码精简 99.5%

Why it matters：这是 AI 辅助大规模形式化数学工程的重要实践，展示了模型在代码重构与证明精简上的实际能力。

item.title: Zhihu Confirms Indirect Low Single-Digit Stake in DeepSeek
item.description:

He stressed the investment will not come at the expense of the core business or financial stability, and buybacks will continue. item.title: ChatGPT Chat and Work Modes Share One Usage Meter, Heavy Users Hit Caps Sooner
item.description:
OpenAI has changed how ChatGPT subscription usage is metered, merging the standard Chat mode and the long-running multi-step Work mode into a single usage pool; Work previously shared a pool with the Codex coding agent. Instant chats stay off the meter and keep working after the budget runs out, concentrating the squeeze on reasoning and agentic workloads. Because usage is measured in tokens, model choice and task size now directly determine how fast a subscriber burns through a plan.

原文标题：ChatGPT 聊天与工作模式合并计量 重度用户额度将更快耗尽

Why it matters：订阅额度计量规则变化直接影响 ChatGPT 重度用户的成本与使用策略，属于值得关注的产品政策调整。

item.title: Johns Hopkins and Together AI Find Higher Reasoning Effort Can Hurt Accuracy
item.description:
A new Johns Hopkins and Together AI paper finds that higher reasoning effort often fails tasks that lower effort already solved, even as overall accuracy rises. Testing 8 models including GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5 across math, science, terminal and coding benchmarks, the authors show that starting at low effort and escalating only after a verified failure matches or beats fixed top effort for every model, at a median 41.5% lower GPQA cost.

原文标题：约翰霍普金斯与 Together AI 研究发现高推理努力反而更差

Why it matters：该研究给出可立即落地的智能体成本优化策略，并揭示推理努力并非越高越好的反直觉结论。

item.title: Samsung and SK Hynix License YMTC Xtacking Stacking Tech
item.description:
Nikkei Asia reports that Samsung and SK Hynix have secured partial rights to YMTC's Xtacking architecture via cross-licensing agreements for 3D NAND stacking. By placing peripheral circuits above memory cells, Xtacking cuts die area by roughly 25%, shortens development by three months and production cycles by 20%, marking a rare case of Korean memory giants adopting core architecture from a Chinese challenger.

原文标题：三星与 SK 海力士获长江存储 Xtacking 技术授权

Why it matters：存储三巨头首次在核心堆叠架构上形成反向技术授权，是 NAND 竞争格局与知识产权版图的重要信号。

item.title: US AI Chip Export Controls Left 18-Month Licensing Gap
item.description:
Reuters reports that the Trump administration shelved Biden's global licensing rule in May 2025 and only replaced it on November 16, 2026, leaving an 18-month window in which data centers in Singapore and Malaysia could buy Nvidia chips without licenses and rent compute to Chinese firms. The replacement rule imposes licenses on advanced chips bound for Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil, and caps Chinese-headquartered firms' access to advanced AI compute above 12M TPP at any data center worldwide.

原文标题：美国 AI 芯片管制出现 18 个月空窗期

Why it matters：这是出口管制体系一次长达 18 个月的实质性监管真空，直接改变全球 AI 算力流向与合规成本。

item.title: Sand AI Debuts 480B-Parameter MAGI-2 Video Model at Top of Rankings
item.description:

It generates up to 30 seconds of 1080p 25fps audio-video with omni-reference across up to 20 media items, is live on Higgsfield, VidMuse and the Sand AI Open Platform, and the company has signaled intent to follow with open source releases.

原文标题：Sand AI 发布 480B 参数 MAGI-2 视频模型

Why it matters：480B 参数 MoE 视频模型以约七分之一价格登顶图生视频榜单，并承诺后续开源，是视频生成竞争格局的重要变量。

item.description:
Anthropic researcher Luke Sernau and colleagues, working with Claude, refactored the previously 17.4-million-line Lean formalization of the Riemann Hypothesis down to roughly 76,000 lines, a 99.56% reduction, alongside a 300,000-line annotated reading version. item.title: China Sets 2030 Target for 6G Rollout in New Telecom Plan

The plan centers on 5G-A/6G, 10-gigabit optical networks and satellite internet, and calls for network architecture to evolve around AI applications, multi-tier compute facilities and network large models for intelligent operations.

item.title: 斯坦福研究：圣克拉拉县 72% 无律师诉状含 AI 起草痕迹
item.description:
斯坦福研究团队分析美国四州法院 127,518 起诉讼后发现，圣克拉拉县无律师代理的诉状中约 72% 带有 AI 起草特征，较 2024 年的 19% 大幅上升；有律师代理的诉状同期也从 5% 升至 34%。由于法律文书高度程式化，单一 AI 检测器对同一批文书的判定结果在 10% 至 98% 之间波动，研究者改用法官查实引用虚假判例的文书来校准检测器，但该方法只能估计法院整体层面的 AI 使用率，无法证明单份文书是否由 AI 生成。

Why it matters：首次以十万级诉状样本量化 AI 在法律实务中的渗透速度，并坦诚披露检测方法的局限。
